title: Heavylytras
description: Heavylytras disables the elytra if you wear netherite, discouraging use in combat.
body:
[![github-singular](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/github-singular_vector.svg)](https://github.com/therealfickle/Heavylytras)
[![fabric](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/fabric_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
[![discord-plural](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://discord.gg/Jsm5vNgQDC)

# What does this mod provide?
- Disables the elytra when using netherite armor
- Thats it.

# How do i use this mod?
To use Heavylytras, you need to install it on either your dedicated server, or on your client if you want to use the mod in singleplayer. **You do not need the mod on your client if its on a server.**

You can also change which items are affected by this mod by modifying the "HEAVY_ARMORS" tag using datapacks.

## Why did you make this?
I made this mod to discourage the usage of the elytra in combat :D
